subject: New role, same Alyssa - Reconnecting at Encord!
text:
Hi Odi, 

Surprise - I’m at Encord now! I hope all is well and would love to reconnect now that I'm in a new role. 

Encord works with many of the leading Physical AI & ADAS teams (inc. Woven by Toyota, Pickle Robot, RIOS Intelligent Machines, Rapid Robotics,  etc) - who faced challenges with existing data curation solutions, lacking the speed & scalability required to efficiently search through their training sets (using embeddings visualization & quality metric filters) & programmatically create datasets / collections. 

We’re essentially enabling Physical AI teams to quickly surface data for re-training, and build better models, faster, so thought it’d be relevant to get your thoughts on what we’re building here.

Would love to chat / share some ideas based on what we've been learning from working with the customers mentioned above. Would you be open to catching up next week?

subject: Working w/ SmartEye, Cipia & Toyota | Tobii Autosense
text:
Hi He​, 

I noticed Tobii's recent focus on DMS - especially the EU homologation & large automotive contracts - so thought I'd reach out. I lead an automotive team here at Encord and we’re working w/ a few of your peers (SmartEye, Toyota, Cipia, Nauto, Seeing Machines, etc) to develop new AI/CV products & scale use cases like driver behavior analytics, in-cabin monitoring, safety alerts & 2D/3D Skeletons using a single-camera OMS. 

We're mostly assisting with multimodal data visualisation at scale (billions) & dimensionality reduction for feature engineering, edge case mining & model eval for decision threshold tuning and annotation workflow orchestration as the team size grows or as they expand into more complex modalities like video or audio.
